entries.title: Job 28:1
segments: Surely there is a mine for silver,  And a place for gold which they refine.

entries.title: Job 28:2
segments: Iron is taken out of the earth, And copper is molten out of the stone.

entries.title: Job 28:3
segments: [Man] setteth an end to darkness, And searcheth out, to the furthest bound, The stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.

entries.title: Job 28:4
segments: He breaketh open a shaft away from where men sojourn; They are forgotten of the foot; They hang afar from men, they swing to and fro.

entries.title: Job 28:5
segments: As for the earth, out of it cometh bread; And underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.

entries.title: Job 28:6
segments: The stones thereof are the place of sapphires, And it hath dust of gold.

entries.title: Job 28:7
segments: That path no bird of prey knoweth, Neither hath the falcon's eye seen it:

entries.title: Job 28:8
segments: The proud beasts have not trodden it, Nor hath the fierce lion passed thereby.

entries.title: Job 28:9
segments: He putteth forth his hand upon the flinty rock; He overturneth the mountains by the roots.

entries.title: Job 28:10
segments: He cutteth out channels among the rocks; And his eye seeth every precious thing.

entries.title: Job 28:11
segments: He bindeth the streams that they trickle not;  And the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light.

entries.title: Job 28:12
segments: But where shall wisdom be found? And where is the place of understanding?

entries.title: Job 28:13
segments: Man knoweth not the price thereof; Neither is it found in the land of the living.

entries.title: Job 28:14
segments: The deep saith, It is not in me; And the sea saith, It is not with me.

entries.title: Job 28:15
segments: It cannot be gotten for gold, Neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.

entries.title: Job 28:16
segments: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, With the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

entries.title: Job 28:17
segments: Gold and glass cannot equal it, Neither shall it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.

entries.title: Job 28:18
segments: No mention shall be made of coral or of crystal: Yea, the price of wisdom is above rubies.

entries.title: Job 28:19
segments: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, Neither shall it be valued with pure gold.

entries.title: Job 28:20
segments: Whence then cometh wisdom? And where is the place of understanding?

entries.title: Job 28:21
segments: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, And kept close from the birds of the heavens.

entries.title: Job 28:22
segments: Destruction and Death say, We have heard a rumor thereof with our ears.

entries.title: Job 28:23
segments: God understandeth the way thereof, And he knoweth the place thereof.

entries.title: Job 28:24
segments: For he looketh to the ends of the earth, And seeth under the whole heaven;

entries.title: Job 28:25
segments: To make a weight for the wind: Yea, he meteth out the waters by measure.

entries.title: Job 28:26
segments: When he made a decree for the rain, And a way for the lightning of the thunder;

entries.title: Job 28:27
segments: Then did he see it, and declare it; He established it, yea, and searched it out.

entries.title: Job 28:28
segments: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; And to depart from evil is understanding.
